clean_description: Set during the Napoleonic Wars, this novel follows Captain Will Laurence, who discovers a dragon egg aboard a captured French ship. When the egg hatches, Laurence bonds with the dragon, named Temeraire, and they embark on a journey that intertwines military strategy with the challenges of navigating a world where dragons are used in warfare. Together, they face the complexities of loyalty, friendship, and the impact of war on both humans and dragons.
